newsitem.title: USA: Mallinckrodt says to start $17-mln plant expansion.
newsitem.headline: Mallinckrodt says to start $17-mln plant expansion.

text.p: Mallinckrodt Inc said it planned to break ground Friday on a $17-million expansion of its pharmaceutical plant at Hobart, N.Y.
"The new plant will provide the additional capacity necessary to support the forward-integrating chemical business of Mallinckrodt," said Dan Casey, Hobart's general manager.
Earlier this year, the healthcare and chemicals concern announced its intention to expand the Hobart facilities.
